== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 21 April 2018. The Facebook photo viewer names Tomas Bergmark. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 43 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Kiruna, Sw). The Facebook profile lists Lives in Kiruna, Sweden and From Kiruna, Sweden, matching the roster town. Comments on the photograph are in Swedish.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Tomas Bergmark portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Tomas Bergmark Facebook portrait.jpg]].
